# Pre

::: {.callout-note}
The `uv` python interpreter lives in `~/minstallation/.venvs/KKIK_parse/bin/python`
:::

```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import harmonypy as hm
import session_info
```

Figure settings:

```{python}
plt.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = "Nimbus sans"
```

Random settings / parameters:

```{python}
random_state = 275
min_dist = 0.8
spread = 1.0
```

Create folders for outputs:

```{python}
resdir = "2_integration/outputs/files"
os.makedirs(resdir,exist_ok=True)
```

Read object from previous step:

```{python}
adata = sc.read_h5ad("1_normalization/outputs/files/sc.h5ad")
```

# Pre-integration

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(adata, color=["sample", "log1p_total_counts", "log1p_n_genes_by_counts"])
```

# Run integration with `harmonypy`

```{python}
pcs = adata.obsm['X_pca'] 

# Run Harmony
harmony_out = hm.run_harmony(pcs, adata.obs, "sample")

# Z_corr is already a numpy array with shape (n_cells, n_pcs)
adata.obsm['X_pca_harmony'] = harmony_out.Z_corr
```

Use harmonized PCs for downstream analysis:
```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(
    adata, use_rep="X_pca_harmony", random_state=random_state, key_added="nn_harmony"
)
sc.tl.umap(
    adata,
    random_state=random_state,
    neighbors_key="nn_harmony",
    key_added="umap_harmony",
)
```


```{python}
sc.pl.embedding(
    adata,
    basis="umap_harmony",
    color=["sample", "log1p_total_counts", "log1p_n_genes_by_counts"],
)
```

# Compare embeddings

## PCA vs Harmony

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2)
sc.pl.embedding(
    adata,
    basis="pca",
    color=["sample"],
    ax=axes[0],
    show=False,
)
sc.pl.embedding(
    adata,
    basis="X_pca_harmony",
    color=["sample"],
    ax=axes[1],
    show=False,
)
for ax in axes:
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
fig.show()
```

## UMAP vs UMAP on harmony embeddings

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2)
sc.pl.embedding(
    adata,
    basis="umap",
    color=["sample"],
    ax=axes[0],
    show=False,
)
sc.pl.embedding(
    adata,
    basis="umap_harmony",
    color=["sample"],
    ax=axes[1],
    show=False,
)
for ax in axes:
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
fig.show()
```

# Set min_dist and spread parameters for final umap

```{python}
sc.tl.umap(
    adata,
    random_state=random_state,
    neighbors_key="nn_harmony",
    key_added="umap_harmony",
    min_dist=min_dist,
    spread=spread,
)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.embedding(
    adata,
    basis="umap_harmony",
    color=["sample", "log1p_total_counts", "log1p_n_genes_by_counts"],
)
```

# Save

```{python}
sc.write(adata=adata, filename=f"{resdir}/sc.h5ad", ext="h5ad")
```
